messages:
zahra: Follow-up from the late-night incident: model-gamma p95 jumped and consumed error budget. We need a short-term SLO adjustment for ap-southeast and clear action owners. Proposal: p95 -> 300ms (ap-southeast only) for 7 days; set a 8h error-budget alert at 22%. Thoughts?

 tom: agree to region-only tweak. i'll take dashboard and alerting. will add annotation for the incident window.

 oliver: i'll own remediation: investigate batching, KV hot partitions, and cron overlap. will open RED-4991 and estimate tasks. ETA Tue.

 pager-bot: pager-bot: Incident annotated on timeline by @tom (incident-2026-03-22).

 zahra: owners recorded: dashboard->@tom, remediation->@oliver. zahra: i will draft temp-slo note with expiration 2026-03-30. if 8h burn >22% -> page eng-oncall and trigger rollback route to model-stable.

 tom: dashboard draft: https://dash.redwood.local/d/model-gamma-ap. panels: p50/p95/p99, 8h burn, recent cron jobs. added auto-alert rule slo_burn_model_gamma_8h > 0.22 -> page eng-oncall.

 oliver: opened RED-4991. tests show certain prefixes collapse batches to size 1; plan: min_batch_size=4, deterministic prefix seed, and skip heavy cron window. testing now. config snippet: ```min_batch_size:4
batch_timeout_ms:10
prefix_hash_seed:7```

 zahra: schedule: oliver tests by Tue, staging canary Wed, prod rollout Thu with 30m watch. tom, annotate dashboard with watch window. i'll post final SLO note after jira links are in.

 oliver: staging canary green for the canary slice; p95 ~260ms. attaching perf diffs to RED-4991.

 tom: prod rollout planned. added dashboard watch annotation and a graf alert for recurrence pattern at Fri 21:00 UTC.

 zahra: thanks — closing loop when RED-4991 shows tasks completed and SLO governance note updated.
